import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    v = []
    for i in range(n):
        v.append(int(data[i + 1]))
    
    # nth_element equivalent: find the median element
    v.sort()
    median_index = (n - 1) // 2
    print(v[median_index])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
